create_pipeline_upscale_ldm3d: create a StableDiffusionUpscaleLDM3DPipeline instance to upscale low-resolution RGB and depth images to high resolution
run_pipeline_upscale_ldm3d: run the pipeline with a text prompt, RGB image, depth image, and target resolution to generate high-res output
encode_prompt_ldm3d: encode text prompts into CLIP hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompts and LoRA scaling
check_inputs_ldm3d: validate pipeline inputs including prompt, image, noise level, and callback steps before generation
load_lora_ldm3d: load LoRA weights into the StableDiffusionUpscaleLDM3DPipeline for customized image generation
